files.rationale: Kept PR B's new L2CLOption/WithL2CLOption API together with the indexingMode parameter both sides agree on, and took PR A's removal of the blank line before the indexingMode check.

Took PR B's indexing-mode construction with TestDisableEventDeduplication and its ManagedBySupervisor SyncDeriver field to stay consistent with the merged driver, used tab indentation for the indexing.L2Source embed, and kept PR A's 'indexing-mode' wording in the sync-node assertion message.
Both sides import the indexing package, so the merge keeps that import, takes PR B's move of the event import to op-service/event, and uses correctly tab-indented indexing.DecodeInvalidatedBlockTx.
Both sides renamed the managedMode parameter; kept PR B's managedBySupervisor name to match the ManagedBySupervisor naming used across the merged driver code.
Kept the indexingMode constructor argument and set PR B's ManagedBySupervisor SyncDeriver field from it, so this file matches the merged state.go.
Took PR B's ManagedBySupervisor field and its context-aware onResetEvent and Emit calls, which the rest of the merged code needs, so the managed-mode naming is gone as both PRs intend.
Kept the indexing package import that both sides added, and used PR B's relocated op-service/event package.

PR B's version already has the IndexingMode rename from PR A, plus the newer IndexingEvent stream, event deduplication, context-aware emitter and removal of findLatestValidLocalUnsafe, so I used it as is.
PR B deleted this test because it removed findLatestValidLocalUnsafe; PR A's renamed copy only tests that function and would no longer compile.
Both sides switched to the indexing package; used the correctly tab-indented import and InvalidatedBlockSourceDepositTx call.
Both sides reference indexing.InteropInactiveRPCErrCode; kept the correctly tab-indented version.
